title: Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy dish originating from Syria, this recipe combines the taste of chicken, garlic, and cumin with the convenience of a kebab.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together kebab spice mix, garlic, and olive oil.
2. Add chicken to the bowl and mix until well coated.
3. Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush the grill or grill pan with olive oil and preheat to medium-high heat.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
6. While the kebabs are cooking, toast the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
7. Serve the kebabs hot with toasted pita bread, fresh parsley, and lemon wedges.
8. Garnish with additional kebab spice mix, if desired.
